name: talkfixai
description: TalkFixAI helps you fix things around the home yourself. Describe what's broken and get clear steps one at a time, the safety precautions for that job, the parts you'll need, and an honest answer on when to stop and call a professional. Covers WiFi, plumbing, air conditioning, lighting, breakers, locks, phones and more. Free, with no sign-in.
